findings.provider: The official Pokémon Website in China (www.pokemon.cn) product page
findings.excerpt: <title>宝可梦卡牌 家庭组合 | The official Pokémon Website in China</title> ... <h?>宝可梦卡牌 家庭组合</h?>
findings.identityMatch: Official S-Chinese product page titled with this name. The page does not print the local set code; the link to the code rests on product identity: sH (Family Pokémon Card Game, JP sH 038/053) whose S-Chinese counterpart is the only S-Chinese Family product on the official CN product list; target card CS2DaC 038/053 shares the 053 run size.
findings.notes: The product page body is image-based; only the title/heading text is machine-readable. Promote to high only after the code is read from a card/box image of the product (e.g. the retained specimen image of the target card shows the set mark).

findings.value: 寶可夢集換式卡牌遊戲 Classic
findings.provider: Pokémon Asia official TW site (asia.pokemon-card.com/tw) special product page
findings.excerpt: 「寶可夢集換式卡牌遊戲 Classic」的繁體中文版，將於指定合作商店預約販售。 ... ●商品名稱：寶可夢集換式卡牌遊戲 Classic ... ●發售日：2023年11月10日
findings.identityMatch: Official TW page for the Traditional Chinese edition of Classic, a box of three 60-card decks (妙蛙花&洛奇亞ex牌組, 噴火龍＆鳳王ex牌組, 水箭龜＆水君ex牌組). The page does not print the code CLF; CLF is the Classic deck code (Japanese Classic uses CLF/CLL/CLK, F = Fushigibana/Venusaur deck), and the target card is 016/032 of that deck.
findings.notes: CLF is one deck inside the Classic product; if the dataset names deck-level sets, the deck name on the same page is "妙蛙花&洛奇亞ex牌組" (Venusaur & Lugia ex Deck) — the page does not tie the deck name to the code. The TW card database returns 0 cards for expansionCodes=CLF (Classic cards are not in it; gap, not absence).
